description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Torentify is seeking a Quality Assurance (QA) Tester to support software testing and quality assurance for web-based applications. The role focuses on test planning, design and execution, API and data validation, defect management, and collaboration with product, development, and client teams.
Software Engineer focused on web application testing, test design and execution, API and database validation, and defect tracking

Responsibilities:
• Contribute independently to test design, test planning, and test execution activities
• Test web-based applications and use browser developer tools to investigate and troubleshoot issues
• Collaborate with product management and development teams to understand business requirements and technical specifications
• Interact regularly with clients to understand business scenarios and provide testing and troubleshooting support
• Develop test plans, test cases, and related testing documentation
• Execute test cases and document results to verify application functionality and quality
• Work with APIs and use browser developer tools to validate request and response data
• Write basic database queries to support testing and data validation
• Follow the defect management process to document and track issues
• Collect and analyze relevant information to define problems, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions
• Work with cross-functional teams to meet project deadlines and deliverables
• Adapt to changing requirements and priorities in a fast-paced startup environment

Requirements:
• 1–3 years of relevant QA technical experience
• Experience working within an Agile or Scrum team
• Experience testing web-based applications
• Familiarity with browser developer tools
• Experience working with APIs and validating request and response data
• Ability to develop test plans, test cases, and related test artifacts
• Familiarity with defect management processes
• Ability to write basic database queries
• Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills
• Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions
• Clear written and verbal communication skills
• Ability to work collaboratively across teams and meet deadlines
• Strong attention to detail and a focus on quality and precision

Preferred:
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent educational background
• Knowledge of the health insurance domain
• Advanced SQL skills and knowledge of relational databases
• Familiarity with performance testing concepts and tools
• Experience supporting clients and collaborating with cross-functional teams
• Work authorization in the United States
